steps.instruction: Cut off one RJ45 connector from the cable.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue cable lies coiled with one clear plug attached and one flat-cut bare end.

checks.text: The blue cable is present on the table
Only one clear plug remains attached to the cable

common_mistakes: Cable cut in the middle leaving two short pieces

steps.instruction: Strip about an inch of jacket off the cut end.
steps.done_looks_like: The cut end shows eight small colored wires sticking out of the blue jacket.

checks.text: The blue cable is present on the table
The blue jacket is removed exposing eight small inner wires

common_mistakes: Inner wires nicked or cut short

steps.instruction: Untwist and straighten all eight inner wires.
steps.done_looks_like: Eight straight inner wires fan out from the blue jacket with no twists.

checks.text: The blue cable is present on the table
Eight inner wires are separated straight and the white string is gone

common_mistakes: White pull string left on the end

steps.instruction: Slide a blue boot onto the cable.
steps.done_looks_like: A small blue boot sits around the blue cable below the exposed wires.

checks.text: The blue cable is present on the table
The blue boot is present on the table
The blue boot encircles the cable below the exposed wires

steps.instruction: Line up the wires in 568A order and trim them even.
steps.done_looks_like: Eight flat parallel wires extend in green-first order ready to insert.

checks.text: The blue cable is present on the table
The eight wires lie flat side-by-side in 568A order with even ends

common_mistakes: Wires in 568B order on this end

steps.instruction: Push the ordered wires fully into a new plug.
steps.done_looks_like: The clear plug sits on the wire ends with colored wires visible reaching the front.

checks.text: The blue cable end goes inside the clear plug
All eight wires reach the front gold pins without crossing

common_mistakes: Wires not pushed to the front of the plug
Wires out of order or folded back

steps.instruction: Crimp the new plug with the crimping tool.
steps.done_looks_like: The clear plug is flattened onto the wires with blue jacket tucked inside the plug.

checks.text: The blue cable jacket stays inside the clear plug after crimping
The plug is crimped tight with gold pins pressed down

common_mistakes: Blue jacket left outside the plug

steps.instruction: Slide the blue boot up over the crimped plug.
steps.done_looks_like: The blue boot covers the back of the clear plug on the finished crossover end.

checks.text: Two clear plugs are attached to the cable ends
The blue boot is pushed tight over the back of the crimped plug

common_mistakes: Boot not seated over the plug
